title: Euler Constraints and the Cubic Criticality of Complete Bipartite Preference Structures
summary: We introduce a polyhedral realizability problem for complete bipartite preference structures, the two-sided strict preference profiles that underlie the stable marriage problem. Given two parts M and W of size k, a strong polyhedral realization asks for a bipartite polyhedral graph with bipartition classes of size k in which every vertex is adjacent to all but one vertex on the opposite side.
